bug_semantics: Create-only TUS POST registers an incomplete upload under a lexical RealPath key. Default in-memory ttlcache eviction then calls raw os.Remove on that frozen path, bypassing ScopedFs/within() and Perm.Delete. During the 3-minute TTL an ancestor can be swapped for an escaping symlink so the unlink follows out of scope (CWE-59/CWE-367). Redis cache is not this sink.

Parent 76cf7bd5c2357f7950617f6ea4b5e65e8b4e8429 still uses sync.Map and has no eviction delete. Squash 0f27c91eca581482ce4f82f6429f5dac12f8b64e landed that sink on master; 08d7a1504c42c115fdd82d3845694fe87147f1db later moved the same os.Remove into http/upload_cache_memory.go (parent b8da36e63033f137ef08cae2b109f267978c1461 already had the lines in tus_handlers.go).
